title: Namaz of Imam Hasan Askari (a)
introduction:
NAMAZ OF IMAM AL-’ASKARI (A)

This prayer consists of four units in the first two of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and Surah al-Zalzalah (No. 99) is repeated fifteen times, and the last two of which Surah al-Faatehah is recited once and Surah al-Tawheed is repeated fifteen times. After the namaz recite the dua of Imam Askari (a.s.):
